files.description: Mongoose schema for the AddListItemsData entity to store item information including image URL, name, description, price, quantity, and creation timestamp.
Route Handler implementing the item collection endpoints (create/list) with validation for required fields and image constraints.
API service layer to encapsulate calls to the backend endpoints for adding and retrieving items.
Main page component for the Add & List Items feature, including form for adding items and grid for listing them, matching the approved UI design.
Add a navigation link to the new 'Add & List Items' page from the home page.
